summary: SOS emergency audio feature verified end-to-end. Backend upload/track-expose/public-playback all pass (7/7 pytest). Owner enforcement, empty rejection, cross-journey isolation, unauth playback and content-type all correct. Frontend: family /track page shows Emergency Audio section with <audio> player pointing at the correct public streaming endpoint; dealer Command Center detail modal contains zero audio elements/text; live journey SOS panel renders sos-audio-recorder block (recording or graceful mic-unavailable path).
critical_code_review_comments: LiveJourney.jsx is 712 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline; consider splitting SOS panel + audio recorder logic into a hook/component (non-blocking).
Public sos-audio playback endpoint sets Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600 — a family emergency audio might benefit from private caching or a shorter TTL since share_token can circulate widely.
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_/UI_TEST_/MIC_TEST_/LONG_TEST_ journeys for the rider usr_test1 with uploaded audio clips (aud_*). Safe to prune from db.journeys and db.sos_audios if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_sos_audio.py covers upload owner/empty/success, track exposure, playback content-type & bytes, wrong audio_id, wrong token, cross-journey isolation, unauthenticated playback. Frontend live journey completes very quickly on short routes (route array length dictates duration); to open the SOS panel via UI, create a journey with >=100 route points and click the exact-text 'SOS' button (there are two SOS-labelled buttons in the header: 'Voice SOS' toggle and solid red 'SOS'). Emergent object storage init log 'Object storage initialized' present at startup.
